Station Notes - Elbridge / Hart (MI) 
 
 
06/15/2022: Station Maintenance:                                         [1000] 
 
           - routine site maintenance, including: 
               - checked anemometer (replace bearings next site visit) 
               - checked wind vane (properly aligned) 
               - checked pyranometer (readjusted mount / level) 
               - checked / tested battery 
               - checked / tested leaf wetness [canopy] (good)* 
               - checked / tested leaf wetness [standard] (good) 
               - checked / tested solar panels 
               - cleaned battery box 
               - cleaned HMP155 (atmp/relh) sensor and radiation shield 
               - cleaned tipping-bucket rain gauge 
               - weed removal (not needed... site well maintained) 
 
               * canopy sensor is located 40ft east of station under cherry tree
